name: thinqos
description: Use your thinqOS Mind, manage authorized resources and consult your thinqOS agents from your AI tools through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Your own Mind across AI tools
interface.longDescription: Connects your thinqOS Mind, resource management and agent consultation. Recall your preferences and decisions, consult the Mind before consequential work, manage resources you are authorized to change, or ask thinqOS Help and your other agents to do work. Current operations and permissions are checked through the connected tools. Requires a thinqOS account.
defaultPrompt: Recall what my thinqOS Mind knows about this task.
